Contact and report an error

For evidence corrections, data questions, accessibility issues, privacy questions or technical problems, write to office@causewaygrp.com. Use “Yemen Financial Inclusion Evidence” in the subject and add the issue type where useful.

01

Report a suspected error

If possible, include the evidence record ID, source ID, page address, the value or statement you are challenging, and the source or reasoning supporting the correction. Send the report to office@causewaygrp.com. A report is an input to review; it does not silently change the public record.

02

What you can contact us about

Evidence or source corrections; broken source links; reuse/rights questions; accessibility problems; privacy questions; and technical issues affecting the ability to inspect or use the evidence.

03

Contact channel

The monitored public contact channel for this resource is office@causewaygrp.com. No response time has been published for this channel.

04

Protect personal and sensitive information

When reporting an issue, do not send passwords, financial credentials, beneficiary-level records, precise sensitive locations or other personal data that is unnecessary to investigate the problem.
